mode: No new image generation. Existing photographs embedded unchanged, with native typography/layout. Three data-driven renderers each use two content inputs.
fontLicensePolicy: Original sources and OFL notices retained. Source Sans3 Regular and Source Serif4 Display (weight400, optical-size60 instance) embedded unchanged as PVTemplateBody/PVTemplateTitle.
comparisonPolicy: Title viewport height and downstream translation; supplied eligibility/action group translations; or image visibility, longer note viewport, content translation and related auto-height card surfaces. Same words, font families/sizes/weights, local anchors, colors and image bytes/crops remain fixed within each pair. Ordinary short-title, standard-price and October inputs remain unchanged controls. Title line breaks are supplied editorially; no automatic line-breaking engine.

limitations: Static fictional artwork, not complete InDesign/email/presentation template products or implemented publication workflow. Before deliberately clips supplied title/note text and inherits a stale image; after reveals/removes it according to declared rules. No timed production, comprehension, error-rate or physical print-proof results.

sources.supports: Adobe documents reusable parent pages and inheritance of repeated elements. This supports one production mechanism, not the editorial content obligations proposed here.
